work.title: Plastic-Wrapped Disc
work.description: Crinkled silver mylar or plastic sheeting, vertically oriented and subdivided by faint rectangular seams, fills the composition entirely. Centered at the lower edge, one gold compact disc sits partially tucked beneath a fold of the material, its circular form and label visible against the reflective, irregularly creased surface.
work.composition: monochrome wrapped panel, single disc anchor
